text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Water Services Corporation launches campaign to save ground water. The corporation said the supply of ground water was rapidly decreasing because of urbanisation and over-extraction. Its quality was also falling because of contamination from careless waste disposal.
- Young man killed in quarry accident. A 19-year-old was accidentally buried in sand in a quarry where he started working three weeks ago.
- Prisoner found to be in possession of drugs. His wife suspected of giving it to him.
